record.issue_text: PollFeed crashes on feeds without a content element: CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError when i.content is nil (feeds using only <description>/<summary>), and with retry: false and no per-item rescue one malformed item kills the whole batch

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item lacks `content` (e.g., only has `description`/`summary`), `i.content` can be `nil`, making `nil.scrub` raise `NoMethodError`. The job also sets `sidekiq_options retry: false` and has no per-item rescue, so a single malformed item would abort the whole polling run.
